ayahs.textUthmani: يسٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يسٓ ۝١
ayahs.translation: Yā, Seen.[1260]
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa-Seeen
ayahs.translationClear: Ya, Seen.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ ۙ‏
ayahs.translation: By the wise[1261] Qur’ān,
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-Qur-aanil Hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: By the Wise Quran.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
ayahs.transliteration: Innaka laminal mursaleen
ayahs.translationClear: You are one of the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍؕ‏
ayahs.translation: On a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: On a straight path.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: تَنۡزِيۡلَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الرَّحِيۡمِ ۙ‏
ayahs.translation: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.transliteration: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem
ayahs.translationClear: The revelation of the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّاۤ اُنۡذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
ayahs.transliteration: Litunthira qawmam maaa unthira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon
ayahs.translationClear: To warn a people whose ancestors were not warned, and so they are unaware.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلٰٓى اَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: The Word was realized against most of them, for they do not believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِىۡۤ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ اَغۡلٰلًا فَهِىَ اِلَى الۡاَ ذۡقَانِ فَهُمۡ مُّقۡمَحُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal athqaani fahum muqmahoon
ayahs.translationClear: We placed shackles around their necks, up to their chins, so they are stiff-necked.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ سَدًّا وَّمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدًّا فَاَغۡشَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw wa-min khalfihim saddan fa-aghshai-naahum fahum laa yubsiroon
ayahs.translationClear: And We placed a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them, so they cannot see.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anthartahum am lam tunthirhum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: It is the same for them, whether you warn them, or do not warn them—they will not believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ‌ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّمَا تُنۡذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِىَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّاَجۡرٍ كَرِيۡمٍ‏
ayahs.translation: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa tunthiru manit taba 'ath-Thikra Wa-khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem
ayahs.translationClear: You warn only him who follows the Message, and fears the Most Gracious inwardly. So give him good news of forgiveness, and a generous reward.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ‌ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡىِ الۡمَوۡتٰى وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوۡا وَاٰثَارَهُمۡؕ وَكُلَّ شَىۡءٍ اَحۡصَيۡنٰهُ فِىۡۤ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa Wa-naktubu maa qaddamoo Wa-aasaarahum; Wa-kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: It is We who revive the dead; and We write down what they have forwarded, and their traces. We have tallied all things in a Clear Record.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلًا اَصۡحٰبَ الۡقَرۡيَةِ ​ۘ اِذۡ جَآءَهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۚ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
ayahs.transliteration: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; ith jaaa'ahal mursaloon
ayahs.translationClear: And cite for them the parable of the landlords of the town—when the messengers came to it.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِمُ اثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مُّرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏

words.translation: but they denied both of them

ayahs.translation: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
ayahs.transliteration: Ith arsalnaaa ilaihimus naini fakaththaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon
ayahs.translationClear: We sent them two messengers, but they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third. They said, “We are messengers to you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوۡا مَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُـنَا ۙ وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍۙ اِنۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا تَكۡذِبُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa Wa-maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takthiboon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “You are nothing but humans like us, and the Gracious did not send down anything; you are only lying.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ اِنَّاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَاۤ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
ayahs.translation: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And our only duty is clear communication.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ‌ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۚ لَٮِٕنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهُوۡا لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il lam tantahoo lanar-jumannakum Wa-la-yamassan-nakum minnaa 'athaabun aleem
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will stone you, and a painful punishment from us will befall you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ‌ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم‌ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوۡا طٰۤٮِٕـرُكُمۡ مَّعَكُمۡؕ اَٮِٕنۡ ذُكِّرۡتُمۡ ؕ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it[1262] because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in thukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Your evil omen is upon you. Is it because you were reminded? But you are an extravagant people.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسۡعٰى قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوا الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluien yas'aa qaala yaa-qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen
ayahs.translationClear: Then a man came running from the remotest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اتَّبِعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّا يَسۡـــَٔلُكُمۡ اَجۡرًا وَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
ayahs.transliteration: Ittabi'oo mal laa yas'alukum ajranw wa-hum muhtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: Follow those who ask you of no wage, and are themselves guided.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا لِىَ لَاۤ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنِىۡ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa liya laaa a'budul lathee fataranee Wa-ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.translationClear: And why should I not worship Him who created me, and to whom you will be returned?

ayahs.textUthmani: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: ءَاَ تَّخِذُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً اِنۡ يُّرِدۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّىۡ شَفَاعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـــًٔا وَّلَا يُنۡقِذُوۡنِ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
ayahs.transliteration: A-attakhithu min dooniheee aalihatan ien yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril laa tughni 'annee shafaa-'atuhum shai-'anw wa-laa yunqithoon
ayahs.translationClear: Shall I take other gods instead of Him? If the Merciful desires harm for me, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor will they save me.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنِّىۡۤ اِذًا لَّفِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee ithal lafee dalaa-lim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: In that case, I would be completely lost.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنِّىۡۤ اٰمَنۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَاسۡمَعُوۡنِؕ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee aamantu bi-Rabbikum fasma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ‌ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلِ الۡجَـنَّةَ ؕ قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِىۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: It was said, "Enter Paradise."[1263] He said, "I wish my people could know
ayahs.transliteration: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa-laita qawmee ya'lamoon

footnotes.1263: An abrupt transfer to the Hereafter conveys the meaning that the man met a violent death at the hands of the disbelievers and so was martyred for the cause of Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: It was said, “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew.

ayahs.textUthmani: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: بِمَا غَفَرَلِىۡ رَبِّىۡ وَجَعَلَنِىۡ مِنَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
ayahs.transliteration: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee Wa-ja'alanee minal mukrameen
ayahs.translationClear: How my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honored.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهٖ مِنۡ جُنۡدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُـنَّا مُنۡزِلِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas samaaa'i Wa-maa kunnaa munzileen
ayahs.translationClear: After him, We sent down no hosts from heaven to his people; nor would We ever send any down.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ خٰمِدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: It was not but one shout,[1264] and immediately they were extinguished.
ayahs.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-ithaa hum khaamidoon

footnotes.1264: From Gabriel or a blast from the sky.

ayahs.translationClear: It was just one Cry, and they were stilled.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ‌ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى الۡعِبَادِ ؔ​ۚ مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa-hasratan 'alal 'ibaaad; maa ya'teehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi-'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Alas for the servants. No messenger ever came to them, but they ridiculed him.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَمۡ اَهۡلَـكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.translation: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them[1265] will not return?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlak-naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon

footnotes.1265: i.e., to those living presently in the world.

ayahs.translationClear: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them; and that unto them they will not return?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنۡ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-in kullul lammaa jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.translationClear: All of them, every single one of them, will be arraigned before Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الۡاَرۡضُ الۡمَيۡتَةُ ۖۚ اَحۡيَيۡنٰهَا وَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبًّا فَمِنۡهُ يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa Wa-akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu ya'kuloon
ayahs.translationClear: And there is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life, and produce from it grains from which they eat.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡعُيُوۡنِۙ‏

words.translation: and We caused to gush forth

ayahs.translation: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw Wa-a'naabinw Wa-fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon
ayahs.translationClear: And We place in it gardens of palm-trees and vines, and cause springs to gush out of it.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ‌ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لِيَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡ ثَمَرِهٖ ۙ وَمَا عَمِلَـتۡهُ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ​ ؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: That they may eat of His fruit.[1266] And their hands have not produced it,[1267] so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: Li-ya'kuloo min samarihee Wa-maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon

footnotes.1266: i.e., that which Allāh has produced for them.
footnotes.1267: An alternative meaning is "And [eat from] what their hands have produced [i.e., planted and harvested]." Both are grammatically correct.

ayahs.translationClear: That they may eat from its fruits, although their hands did not make it. Will they not be appreciative?

ayahs.textUthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۡۢبِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Exalted is He who created all pairs[1268] - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Subhaanal lathee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu Wa-min anfusihim Wa-mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs; of what the earth produces, and of their own selves, and of what they do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيۡلُ ۖۚ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّظۡلِمُوۡنَۙ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And a sign for them is the night. We remove[1269] from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-ithaa hum muzlimoon

footnotes.1269: Literally, "strip" or "peel." Sunlight projected onto the earth is removed from it as the earth turns and night approaches.

ayahs.translationClear: Another sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are in darkness.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِىۡ لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ​ؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِؕ‏
ayahs.translation: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; thaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: And the sun runs towards its destination. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالۡعُرۡجُوۡنِ الۡقَدِيۡمِ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
ayahs.transliteration: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur-joonil qadeem
ayahs.translationClear: And the moon: We have disposed it in phases, until it returns like the old twig.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ‌ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا الشَّمۡسُ يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لَهَاۤ اَنۡ تُدۡرِكَ الۡقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ​ؕ وَكُلٌّ فِىۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
ayahs.transliteration: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara walal lailu saabiqun nahaar; Wa-kullun fee falaki yasbahoon
ayahs.translationClear: The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day. Each floats in an orbit.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمۡ اَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِى الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۙ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers[1270] in a laden ship.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa thurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon

footnotes.1270: Usually meaning "descendants" or "offspring," the word "dhurriyyah" is used here to denote forefathers (their being the offspring of Noah), who were saved from the flood.

ayahs.translationClear: Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden Ark.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ مَا يَرۡكَبُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-khalaqnaa lahum mim mislihee maa yarkaboon
ayahs.translationClear: And We created for them the like of it, in which they ride.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيۡخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡقَذُوۡنَۙ‏ ﻿﻿

words.translation: (would be) a responder to a cry

ayahs.translation: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum Wa-laa hum yunqathoon
ayahs.translationClear: If We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be saved.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيۡنٍ‏
ayahs.translation: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa rahmatam minnaa Wa-mataa'an ilaa heen
ayahs.translationClear: Except by a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوۡا مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;[1271] perhaps you will receive mercy..."[1272]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ithaa qeela lahumut taqoo maa baina aideekum Wa-maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon

footnotes.1271: Of sins or of life in this world and the Hereafter.
footnotes.1272: The conclusion of this sentence is understood to be "...they ignored the warning."

ayahs.translationClear: Yet when it is said to them, “Beware of what lies before you, and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa ta'teehim min aayatim min Aayaati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
ayahs.translationClear: Yet never came to them a sign of their Lord’s signs, but they turned away from it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ ۙ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اَنُطۡعِمُ مَنۡ لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ اَطۡعَمَهٗٓ ۖ  اِنۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ithaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal latheena kafaroo lillatheena aamanooo anut'imu mal law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided for you,” those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Shall we feed someone whom Allah could feed, if He so willed? You must be deeply misguided.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-yaqooloona mataa haathal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “When will this promise be, if you are truthful?”

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: They do not await except one blast[1273] which will seize them while they are disputing.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan ta'khuthuhum Wa-hum yakhissimoon

footnotes.1273: Literally, "cry" or "shriek," meaning the first blast of the Horn which will strike dead every living thing on the earth without warning.

ayahs.translationClear: All they can expect is a single blast, which will seize them while they feud.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ تَوۡصِيَةً وَّلَاۤ اِلٰٓى اَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yastatee'oona taw-siyatanw wa-laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon
ayahs.translationClear: They will not be able to make a will, nor will they return to their families.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّوۡرِ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ يَنۡسِلُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And the Horn will be blown;[1274] and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-nufikha fis soori faithaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon

footnotes.1274: For the second time, signaling the Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: The Trumpet will be blown, then behold, they will rush from the tombs to their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا‌ۜ‌ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۡۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنۡ مَّرۡقَدِنَاۘهٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaa-wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haatha maa wa'adar Rahmanu Wa-sadaqal mursaloon
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “Woe to us! Who resurrected us from our resting-place? This is what the Most Gracious had promised, and the messengers have spoken the truth.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
ayahs.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-ithaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.translationClear: It will be but a single scream; and behold, they will all be brought before Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـــًٔا وَّلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, no soul will be wronged in the least, and you will be recompensed only for what you used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَـنَّةِ الۡيَوۡمَ فِىۡ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
ayahs.transliteration: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
ayahs.translationClear: The inhabitants of Paradise, on that Day, will be happily busy.

ayahs.textUthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: هُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُهُمۡ فِىۡ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الۡاَرَآٮِٕكِ مُتَّكِـــُٔوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
ayahs.transliteration: Hum Wa-azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon
ayahs.translationClear: They and their spouses, in shades, reclining on couches.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمۡ مَّا يَدَّعُوۡنَ​ ۖ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
ayahs.transliteration: Lahum feehaa faakiha-tunw wa-lahum maa yadda'oon
ayahs.translationClear: They will have therein fruits. They will have whatever they call for.

ayahs.textUthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: سَلٰمٌ قَوۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيۡمٍ‏
ayahs.translation: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
ayahs.transliteration: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem
ayahs.translationClear: Peace—a saying from a Most Merciful Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَامۡتَازُوا الۡيَوۡمَ اَيُّهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.[1275]
ayahs.transliteration: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon

footnotes.1275: i.e., remove yourself from the ranks of the believers to be distinguished from them.

ayahs.translationClear: But step aside today, you criminals.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمۡ اَعۡهَدۡ اِلَيۡكُمۡ يٰبَنِىۡۤ اٰدَمَ اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوا الشَّيۡطٰنَ​​ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَـكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ ۙ‏
ayahs.translation: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
ayahs.transliteration: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not serve the devil? That he is your sworn enemy?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى‌ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡنِىۡ ​ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ani 'budoonee; haathaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: And that you shall serve Me? This is a straight path.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا‌ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدۡ اَضَلَّ مِنۡكُمۡ جِبِلًّا كَثِيۡرًا​ ؕ اَفَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: He has misled a great multitude of you. Did you not understand?

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
ayahs.transliteration: Haathihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon
ayahs.translationClear: This is Hellfire, which you were promised.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِصۡلَوۡهَا الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."[1276]
ayahs.transliteration: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
ayahs.translationClear: Roast in it today, because you persistently disbelieved.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلٰٓى اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَاۤ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ اَرۡجُلُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim Wa-tukallimunaaa aideehim Wa-tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.translationClear: On this Day, We will seal their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to everything they had done.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَـطَمَسۡنَا عَلٰٓى اَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَاسۡتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰى يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?[1277]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-law nashaaa'u lata-masna 'alaaa aiyyunihim fasta-baqus siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon

footnotes.1277: Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have left man without means of guidance in the life of this world, although in His mercy He did not.

ayahs.translationClear: If We will, We can blind their eyes as they rush towards the path—but how will they see?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰى مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.[1278]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon

footnotes.1278: He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have prevented man from taking any action to benefit himself in this world or the Hereafter, yet He did not.

ayahs.translationClear: And if We will, We can cripple them in their place; so they can neither move forward, nor go back.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ‌ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنۡ نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُـنَكِّسۡهُ فِى الۡخَـلۡقِ​ؕ اَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;[1279] so will they not understand?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-man nu-'ammirhu nunakkishu fil khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon

footnotes.1279: In his physical and mental capacity.

ayahs.translationClear: Whomever We grant old age, We reverse his development. Do they not understand?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ‌ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ الشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لَهٗؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ وَّقُرۡاٰنٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra Wa-maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa thikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: We did not teach him poetry, nor is it proper for him. It is only a reminder, and a Clear Quran.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّيُنۡذِرَ مَنۡ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: To warn whoever is alive[1280] and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyunthira man kaana haiyyanw wa-yahiqqal qawlu 'alal kaafireen

footnotes.1280: In heart and mind, i.e., the believers.

ayahs.translationClear: That he may warn whoever is alive, and prove the Word against the faithless.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡنَاۤ اَنۡعَامًا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مٰلِكُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands[1281] have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not seen that We created for them, of Our handiwork, livestock that they own?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَذَلَّـلۡنٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوۡبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-thallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum Wa-minhaa ya'kuloon
ayahs.translationClear: And We subdued them for them. Some they ride, and some they eat.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ‌ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ​ؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lahum feehaa manaa-fi'u Wa-mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: And they have in them other benefits, and drinks. Will they not give thanks?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.translation: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: Wattakhathoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
ayahs.translationClear: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than Allah, that perhaps they may be helped.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَهُمۡۙ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.[1282]
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum Wa-hum lahum jundum muhdaroon

footnotes.1282: Maintaining and protecting their "gods." Another interpretation is that they (i.e., the gods) will be soldiers set against them in Hellfire.

ayahs.translationClear: They cannot help them, although they are arrayed as troops for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ‌ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡ​ۘ اِنَّا نَـعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona Wa-maa yu'linoon
ayahs.translationClear: So let their words not sadden you. We know what they conceal, and what they reveal.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
ayahs.translation: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once[1283] he is a clear adversary?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-ithaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

footnotes.1283: i.e., as soon as he becomes self-sufficient.

ayahs.translationClear: Does the human being not consider that We created him from a seed? Yet he becomes a fierce adversary.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ‌ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَضَرَبَ لَـنَا مَثَلًا وَّ نَسِىَ خَلۡقَهٗ​ ؕ قَالَ مَنۡ يُّحۡىِ الۡعِظَامَ وَهِىَ رَمِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And he presents for Us an example[1284] and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-daraba lanaa maslanw wa-nasiya khalqahoo qaala maien yuhyil 'izaama Wa-hiya rameem

footnotes.1284: Attempting to establish the finality of death.

ayahs.translationClear: And he produces arguments against Us, and he forgets his own creation. He says, “Who will revive the bones when they have decayed?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ‌ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيۡهَا الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡشَاَهَاۤ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ​ ؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيۡمُ ۙ‏
ayahs.translation: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yuh-yeehal latheee ansha-ahaaa awwala marrah; Wa-Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “He who initiated them in the first instance will revive them. He has knowledge of every creation.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اۨلَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الۡاَخۡضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ مِّنۡهُ تُوۡقِدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
ayahs.transliteration: Allathee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-ithaaa antum minhu tooqidoon
ayahs.translationClear: He who produced fuel for you from the green trees, with which you kindle a fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم‌ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَيۡسَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ يَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۡؕ بَلٰی وَهُوَ الۡخَـلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
ayahs.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.transliteration: Awa-laisal lathee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa Wa-Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Certainly. He is the Supreme All-Knowing Creator.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّمَاۤ اَمۡرُهٗۤ اِذَاۤ اَرَادَ شَیْـًٔـا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa amruhooo ithaaa araada shai'an aien yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon
ayahs.translationClear: His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it, “Be,” and it comes to be.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَسُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَـكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-Subhaanal lathee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw wa-ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.translationClear: So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will be returned.
